verdict.rationale: Ashby's public API and webhooks (candidate, application, job-posting endpoints with pagination/sync tokens) provide a technical path to pull data out of the platform, but there is no documented 'export all your data' feature, no bulk export tool, and no explicit open-format data-portability/exit guarantee in the evidence pack. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export feature, documented open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk export, and any statement about data ownership/portability upon leaving.
